items.title: Kairos Power gets up to $100M from Samsung group to build nuclear reactor for Google
items.feed_excerpt: Future Google supplier Kairos Power inked a deal with Samsung C&T to help build its first 50 megawatt nuclear power plant.

items.title: X will now tell users when governments have forced it to limit their posts
items.feed_excerpt: X is expanding its “Under the Hood” transparency tool to show when posts have been downranked or withheld in response to local laws and government demands, including which country made the request.

items.title: Oura’s $2.2B IPO is mostly a payday for existing shareholders
items.feed_excerpt: Forerunner Ventures plans to sell its entire stake in Oura for as much as $1.26 billion, according to Oura's latest IPO filing.

items.title: With Tabby, a former accountant is using AI to make accountants obsolete
items.feed_excerpt: Tabby is designed to be a real-time bookkeeping interface, handling clients’ paperwork as it gives them up-to-the-minute data on their business’s profit and loss.
